verdict.rationale: Secureframe has a dedicated ISO 27001 framework page claiming it helps customers "achieve and maintain ISO 27001 certification," so the framework is supported. That single marketing line is the only ISO-specific evidence, and it does not show first-class depth. missing for 10: evidence of the current Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability generation or management, certification-audit artifacts and auditor workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
